name: Copper Wolf Custom Fabrication
old_description: Copper Wolf Custom Fabrication is a small Colorado based fabrication shop located in the Rocky Mountains. CWCF is owned by both CL and Rebecca Long. 2014 was the year of inception when CL and Rebecca met in welding school. Soon, they fell in love and began the long gratifying journey of starting their own business. CWCF specializes in all custom handmade furnishings, decor, garden gates, handrails, as well as many other custom pieces. All items are made from 100% American grade steel and recycled lumber. about:
Copper Wolf Custom Fabrication operates from Golden, Colorado, in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains. The business traces its inception to 2014, when Chris and Rebecca Long met in welding school and later turned their shared trade into a family-owned venture. After years of running a fabrication shop together, the couple struck out on their own in 2018 to establish CWCF as an independent operation.

The shop focuses on custom metal fabrication, producing handmade furnishings, décor, garden gates, handrails, railings, and stairs. Work is performed on 100 % American‑grade steel and reclaimed lumber, with every piece finished in a durable indoor/outdoor powder coat. All items are made to order, and the facility handles welding, forming, and coating in‑house.

CWCF serves both residential and commercial clients, delivering one‑of‑a‑kind architectural metalwork for homes and businesses in the Golden area and beyond. The company is a member of the Golden Chamber of Commerce, reflecting its local roots.

The Longs emphasize American‑sourced materials, recycled lumber, and a powder‑coat system rated for harsh outdoor exposure as the foundation of their product durability. The business was built on the goal of creating unique, custom pieces that combine functional metalwork with reclaimed wood.
